headline: Medi Assist Healthcare sets November 20, 2026 as record date for buyback
summary: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has officially informed stock exchanges that November 20, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming share buyback. Shareholders whose names appear in the register on this date will be eligible to participate in the corporate action. Retail investors holding the stock should verify their demat holdings ahead of the record date to ensure eligibility. Corporate buybacks generally provide an exit opportunity or return surplus cash to existing investors.
why_it_matters: Holders on record date can tender shares.

headline: Medi Assist Healthcare board approves share buyback
hook: Capital return through tender offer route
summary: Medi Assist Healthcare Services announced that its board of directors approved a share buyback through the tender offer route during a meeting on October 30, 2026. The company will buy back fully paid-up equity shares from existing shareholders. Buybacks typically reduce equity base and can signal management confidence in financial health. Retail shareholders holding the stock can tender their shares for potential gains depending on the buyback price and acceptance ratio.
whats_next: Details on buyback price, record date, and timeline to be announced.
why_it_matters: Opportunity for existing shareholders to tender shares for cash.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / company cash reserves reduced
